book.Title: {{W|Domazaya}}
book.page: Shaggy and horned, she stands on all fours. Her name is of mysticality. Her will is of learned power.
Be it scale morphing, or breath throwing, she is capable of turning the tide of battle in minutes. Her frosty breath is nonetheless kindled and ready to match any foe.

book.Title: {{W|Yattraya}}
book.page: Once a former member of the Sivilao, this Dralk stands as a symbol of freedom. She lost rank after gaining the bravery to free a ormer she had grown attached to during her service. She was branded a traitor and was about to be executed before a Arinate Xirasaphics drove off her once friends in arms.
She now vows to protect those who need it. She retains her fangs, that most of her kindred have lost.

book.Title: {{W|Hishkla}}
book.page: What stands large and tall carries a thundering shot. This was Hishkla's calling. To protect her family, as she left her clan to rubble.

book.Title: {{W|Webby}}
book.page: A drifter of the world. Webby has travelled far and wide, seen many places, and met many folk, helping around whenever. They were gifted a handgonne by a clan elder and helped fend off a Sivilao raiding party.
Webby then went back to wandering. They wandered far and wide, met more folk, and helped more clans. After awhile, they departed the final clan, and sought out more adventurous plans.
